### M. Merritt Smith's Personal Blog

Welcome to my personal site and blog. I write about myself and my research, which currently focuses on using econometrics and machine learning to lift individuals and communities out of poverty. I also sometimes write about my hobbies and other interests, which include but are not limited to running, biking, hobbyist programming, animal cognition, and worldbuilding. Sorry for the mess.
